title.zh: 手机片段：修掉预取与播放抢同一条片段
title.en: Phone clips: stop the prefetch and the player racing for one clip

highlights.zh: 修复竞态：元素已在加载时不再预取；晚到的 blob 直接释放、绝不中途换 src。线上探针实测同一片段曾发出两次 /clips/ 请求（约 400 KB 的重复下载）。
highlights.en: Fixes the race: no prefetch once the element is already loading, and a late blob is released rather than swapped in mid-load. The live probe had measured two /clips/ requests for one clip — a ~400 KB repeat download.

highlights.zh: 类级判据 7 条（已在加载不发请求、竞态中 blob 被释放且 src 不变）。组件级顺序在 jsdom 未覆盖，已如实说明。
highlights.en: Seven class-level criteria, including that an already-loading element issues no fetch and a mid-load blob is released with src unchanged. The component-level ordering is not covered in jsdom and is stated as such.
